// diagnostic

E2419

Error conversion is ambiguous: `{Source}` already reaches `{Target}`

What

Error conversion is ambiguous: `{Source}` already reaches `{Target}`

Why

A source and target may have one unique declared conversion route.

Fix

remove the direct edge or remove one of the intermediate conversion edges.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2419: tests/ui/e2419_error_conv_ambiguous.stderr.

Error [E2419]: error conversion is ambiguous: `RootErr` already reaches `TargetErr`

    |
 10 | impl RightErr -> TargetErr { return TargetErr.One }
    |      ^^^^^^^^
 Why: A source and target may have one unique declared conversion route.
 Fix: remove the direct edge or remove one of the intermediate conversion edges.
